description: This file is a shell script for testing git operations involving subprojects, including setup, cloning, advancing, and fetching to verify correct handling of submodules within a larger project.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a specific name.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Sets up timing or environmental configurations for tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
